admin.rootOnly: Only the super administrator can change these settings; you can view them.

policy.note: Auto review covers every write that needs confirmation; set deleting, bulk changes, sending outside and money to "People only".

policyHint.auto: A read tool runs at once without asking
policyHint.ask: Confirmed before each call; in auto review a write goes to the review model first, a read is never reviewed
policyHint.human: Only you confirm each call: never reviewed, never allowed for the conversation
policyHint.mcpAuto: An administrator confirmed it only reads: runs without asking

model.loadHint: Fill in the address and key to read the available models from the service; with a stored key and an unchanged address it loads directly
model.label: Display name
model.unpricedHint: Models marked "No rates configured" still work and their calls are recorded as unpriced; unpriced calls do not count toward credit budgets.
model.pricingHint: Credits per million tokens. An explicit 0 is free; a model without rates still works, its calls are recorded as unpriced and do not count toward credit budgets.
model.imageCredits: Image credits when billable token usage is unavailable
model.imageFallback: Used only without billable tokens; never added to a token charge.
model.reasoningHint: This capability allows reasoning controls; unchecking it does not turn the model’s reasoning off.
model.vllmHint: vLLM only toggles enable_thinking; low, medium and high do not represent different levels.
model.standardOffHint: Off sends reasoning_effort: none to the standard API; some compatible services reject that value with HTTP 400, so choose Off only when the model supports it.

web.domainsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. example.com; empty: only search results and links the user gives

mcp.autoConfirm: "Read-only" is only what the external server claims and cannot be verified. Let the agent call this tool without asking?
mcp.allowPrivateHint: Allows a private or local address. Turn on only for a server you trust.
mcp.trustConfirm: Trust tool “{tool}” on server “{server}” to run automatically without approval each time? External read-only hints do not prove safety, and tools without that hint may modify data. This does not change confirmation requirements for local tools.

param.pausedHint: New turns and tool calls are refused at once; running turns stop
param.pauseConfirm: Pause the agent? New conversations and tool calls of every user are refused at once, and running turns stop.
param.instructionsHint: Put first into every system prompt, for every tenant.
param.creditsHint: Credit budgets allow up to 6 decimals; 0 is unlimited. Checks use recorded spend before each call; in-flight calls can cross the threshold. Steps, time and concurrency must stay positive.
param.creditInvalid: Enter a nonnegative credit amount with at most 6 decimal places.
param.noCreditCap: There is currently no credit cap: the per-turn, per-user daily and per-tenant daily credit budgets are all 0 (unlimited). Token limits from before the upgrade were not converted to credits; set budgets as needed.

limit.userConcurrentTurns: Turns running at once per user

skill.nameHint: Called with $name in the chat, e.g. fill-customer-info
skill.pasteHint: Choose a file or paste the content of a SKILL.md here (starting with the name, description fields)

instruction.mineHint: Only for your own conversations, e.g. "answer with tables".
instruction.tenantHint: For every user of this tenant, after the platform instructions and before the personal ones.

usage.unreported: Usage was not reported by the provider
usage.estimated: Usage was not reported; credits were estimated from the request and the output so far
usage.legacy: This legacy record lacks details or rates. Historical credits are not reconstructed.
usage.hint: Credits use the model price at the time of each call; changing a price later does not alter existing records.
usage.pendingHint: The call is in progress and final usage has not arrived. It enters the aggregate after completion or interruption is recorded.
usage.partial: Some calls have unknown usage and are not included
usage.empty: No calls in this period yet

integrity.title: Data completeness
integrity.unpriced: {n} calls used a model without rates; they are not counted in credits and not limited by credit budgets. Add the rates under Agent settings → Models (they apply to later calls only).
integrity.unreported: {n} calls have unknown usage (the model service returned none, or the call was stopped, timed out or failed before it ended), so their tokens cannot be counted; for models with rates, credits were estimated from the request and the output so far and count toward budgets.
integrity.legacy: {n} calls are early records saved without details; they are shown as recorded and not recalculated.

reason.key_unreadable: The stored key cannot be decrypted; enter it again
reason.reasoning_off_rejected: The model service does not accept turning reasoning off (reasoning_effort: none)

guide.title: Get started
guide.intro: Complete these steps in order and the assistant is ready to use.
guide.allDone: All required setup is done. You can collapse this guide.
guide.collapsedText: The assistant’s initial setup is complete.
guide.noChat: This account has no chat page, or the assistant is turned off.

providers.title: Set up a model
providers.desc: Add and enable a model service with models (mark a default when there are several). This step is required.

search.title: Web search
search.desc: Set it up when answers need current information; chat works without it.

tools.title: Review tool approval
tools.desc: Make sure tools that change data run only after a person confirms or a review passes.

chat.title: Try it
chat.desc: Ask a question on the chat page and see the result.

guide.unpriced: These models have no rates configured: {models}. Unpriced calls do not count toward credit budgets.

restriction.note: Your tenant can tighten a tool beyond the platform policy to "People only" or "Off", never loosen it: the stricter of the platform's and your tenant's setting applies. These restrictions apply to the in-app assistant only, not to MCP clients connected with a personal access token.
restriction.filter: Filter by title or tool name
